bullets.name: 0.224" (22 ARC) 70GR TAC-TX BT
bullets.notes: Barnes "Bullet Material" category: 100% Copper | Product Details: The TAC-TX bullet is a special purpose expanding all-copper bullet that is optimized around AR platforms. AR's feature shorter carbine length barrels which reduce the muzzle velocity when compared to a standard barrel length. To achieve the same terminal performance that Barnes fans are used to, we added a larger tip to allow more fluid to enter the nose and modified the bullet cavity to maximize expansion at lower velocities. These bullets track straighter through barriers and have better weight retention than lead-core bullets. New for 2026- The .224" 22 CAL 70gr TAC-TX BT was designed and optimized around the 22 ARC and its velocity range. The cannelure is correctly positioned so you can crimp into it. Being a sleek 70gr copper projectile, you need a 1:7 twist rate or faster to stabilize it. The 22 Creedmoor is another great application for this bullet, however, make sure you have a fast enough twist rate. The SAAMI standard for a 22 Creedmoor is slower- 1:8 twist. bullets.name: 0.243" (6MM ARC) 90GR TAC-TX BT
bullets.notes: Barnes "Bullet Material" category: 100% Copper | Product Details: The TAC-TX bullet is a special purpose expanding all-copper bullet that is optimized around AR platforms. AR's feature shorter carbine length barrels which reduce the muzzle velocity when compared to a standard barrel length. To achieve the same terminal performance that Barnes fans are used to, we added a larger tip to allow more fluid to enter the nose and modified the bullet cavity to maximize expansion at lower velocities. These bullets track straighter through barriers and have better weight retention than lead-core bullets. New for 2026- The .243" 6mm 90gr TAC-TX BT was designed and optimized around the 6mm ARC and its velocity range. We offer other .243" 6mm TTSX & TSX bullets that may shoot well in a 6mm ARC, but their internal cavities were designed for higher velocity cartridges and will not provide sufficient terminal performance in this cartridge or similar cartridges. The cannelure is correctly positioned so you can crimp into it. bullets.name: 0.400" 400 LEGEND TSX 190 GR FB
bullets.notes: Barnes "Bullet Material" category: 100% Copper | Product Details: New for 2026- This projectile was designed specifically for the 400 Legend. Thanks to its large open-nose design, fluid can immediately enter the hollow cavity, allowing the bullet to expand rapidly.
